h: Arsenal winger Bukayo Saka reportedly out for up to eight weeks with injury
p: Arsenal winger Bukayo Saka is reportedly facing up to eight weeks on the sidelines with an injury. The club is said to be assessing the best treatment plan. The news is a blow to Arsenal in the Premier League title race.
more: Arsenal have not given a firm return date in the reports seen so far.
He could miss a busy run of league and European games.
